name: attributionRecords
title: Attribution records
description: Optional CMS table linking an economic action to conservation activity and evidence. Lives in the attribution profile. Status is the allocation state.

fields.name: attributionRecordID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the attribution record.

fields.name: sourceID
fields.description: Identifier of the source transaction in the originating system.

fields.name: campaignID
fields.description: Commercial or fundraising campaign the action supported.

fields.name: activityID
fields.description: Conservation activity or survey the amount was allocated toward. Set this only when an explicit allocation exists.

fields.name: status
fields.description: State of the allocation: allocated, inProgress, or completed.

fields.name: allocatedAt
fields.description: Date and time the allocation was recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone designator.

fields.name: evidenceObservationIDs
fields.description: Observation identifiers offered as linked evidence. Pipe-separated. Only list observations that exist in this package.
